review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved and makes AC-001 conditional, so blocking at decisions with requirement-decision-pending is correct; neither the recommended option nor a fixed hypothetical authorizes a human Decision. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, repository identity, base commit, paired case, owner binding and evidence stages agree across the specification and Gold. Empty task and assignment expectations correctly reflect the prohibition on generating assignable tasks before resolution. The supplied source establishes src/middleware/cors/index.ts as the implementation owner and its adjacent test as the verification scope. Configuration confirms separate TypeScript checking and runtime testing, and declaration generation into dist/types; generated declarations and read-only consumers need not be mandatory edits. The absent team members, capability claims and independent reviewer do not invalidate this earlier deterministic decision block under the supplied stage policy. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD trimming. Historical project reuse is compatible with the stated isolation evidence, which supplies no candidate outputs for this bundle. This approval concerns the benchmark expectation, not implementation readiness or task authorization. Digest bindings and provenance were assessed as Service-supplied evidence; I did not independently recompute hashes, execute code or provide human attestation.
